svg.desc: Schneider Factory LOCATION Badr City, Egypt CLIENT Schneider Electric Company COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2010 70 million EGP DISCIPLINES Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Construction of a new factory (18 000 m2) and a new administration building (2 floors, 4500 m2 / floor). BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management. The multidisciplinary services covered landscape design, architectural design, structural / civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.
